runbooks.title: Rollback Recent Deployment
runbooks.description: Roll back the most recent application container image/release to the previous known good deployment tag.
steps: Identify previous stable container image tag or deployment SHA
Issue kubectl rollout undo or helm rollback command
Monitor rolling pod termination and new container health probes
Validate p95 latency and error rate return to baseline

runbooks.title: Rolling Pod Restart
runbooks.description: Perform a rolling restart of service replica pods to clear transient state, leaks, or deadlocks.
steps: Initiate kubectl rollout restart deployment
Observe staggered pod cycling without dropping active traffic
Check memory and CPU utilization after warm-up
Confirm gRPC and HTTP endpoint liveness

runbooks.title: Horizontal Pod Scale Up
runbooks.description: Increase replica count or HPA ceiling to absorb traffic spikes or high request concurrency.
steps: Inspect current replica target and CPU/memory headroom
Increase replica count by 2x or raise HPA maxReplicas
Verify newly scheduled pods become Ready and join load balancer
Monitor distributed request queuing and throughput

runbooks.title: Flush Datastore Redis Cache
runbooks.description: Flush corrupted or stale key-value cart sessions in Redis cache.
steps: Verify direct connectivity to redis-cart service
Issue non-blocking FLUSHDB ASYNC to clear corrupted cart sessions
Monitor cartservice session recreation and Redis memory usage
Verify 200 OK responses on GetCart and AddItem endpoints

runbooks.title: Trip Circuit Breaker & Fallback
runbooks.description: Trip gRPC circuit breaker or enable graceful fallback mode for failing downstream dependency.
steps: Enable fallback mode in service dynamic configuration
Cap downstream call timeout to 500ms with fail-fast response
Return cached or graceful empty response to client
Verify upstream caller p95 latency normalizes

runbooks.title: Enable Ingress Rate Limiting
runbooks.description: Apply client-side rate limiting / token bucket filter on excessive traffic or abusive load.
steps: Assess current RPS vs standard peak traffic baseline
Deploy ingress Envoy token-bucket rate limiter rule
Throttle non-critical and synthetic traffic spikes with 429
Confirm core transaction flow latency stabilizes

runbooks.title: Revert Dynamic Configuration Flag
runbooks.description: Revert dynamic runtime configuration or feature flag to default settings.
steps: Audit configuration change log for modifications in the last 24h
Toggle identified feature flag back to default safe value
Broadcast config update signal or trigger hot reload
Verify thread pool worker utilization normalizes

runbooks.title: Drain & Reset Connection Pool
runbooks.description: Reset stale or leaked TCP connection pool sockets to backing datastore.
steps: Inspect connection pool socket states and pool exhaustion metrics
Trigger orderly connection pool purge and socket re-initialization
Validate TCP keepalive handshakes complete successfully
Observe query latency and socket reuse statistics

runbooks.title: Failover to Legacy Mock Payment Gateway
runbooks.description: Switch legacy direct checkout payment route to mock merchant fallback endpoint.
steps: Check legacy mock gateway endpoint availability
Update DNS alias to redirect direct checkout billing calls
Verify payment transaction authorizations complete
